svg.title: What Command Center is for
svg.desc: Animation with captions: roles scattered across emails and notes are gathered on one board, screened against your rules, turned into a resume and cover letter, and summarised as a daily list, all on your own computer.

g.text: Alert emails, company job pages, spreadsheets and sticky notes. It is easy to lose
track of a role, or forget to follow up.
Real screenshot with made-up demo data
One job board for every role.
Roles are grouped by stage: New, Kits ready, Applied, Interviewing and Closed. You
can search by company or title. These roles are made-up examples.
It screens roles against your own rules.
You set the minimum pay, where you can work, and your work permission. Roles that
do not fit are set aside, and you can see why.
It drafts a resume and cover letter for roles you pick.
It uses only facts from your own profile and never invents anything. You review
and edit everything before you use it.
Real screenshot with made-up demo data
Every morning, a short list of what to do next.
The Today page shows new roles to review, follow-ups and tasks. Your choices teach
it which roles to show first.
It never applies, sends email or logs in for you. You do those yourself.
Everything stays on your computer, and AI is optional.
2. One job board for every role.
3. It screens roles against your own rules.
4. It drafts a resume and cover letter for roles you pick.
5. Every morning, a short list of what to do next.
